_about: Lakes lowered on purpose, with their level gauge (GKD Bayern) and marks in m above sea level, see backend/rowfrog/lake_level.py. Forggensee marks from the gauge's 2025/26 season: full 780.3-780.7 m June to mid-November, lowered from mid-November (below 779.8 m on 15 Nov 2025), lowest 774.1 m in February, below 777.5 m from early December to mid-April, full again end of May. Official marks (Hochwassernachrichtendienst Bayern, as listed by Königswinkel tourism): Normalstauziel 780.50 m from 1 June to 15 October (= full here), Höchststau 782.00 m, lowest winter level 765.00 m, 774.90 m at the start of May. The drained mark of 777.5 m is where the 2025/26 drawdown turns steep, about 3 m below normal; the lake is far below it from December to March.
